mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order}
SELECT FROM payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_attempt SET status=#{status},version=version+1,channel_transaction_id=#{transaction},evidence_json=#{evidence} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_sandbox_ledger(tenant_id,payment_id,order_id,amount,currency,status) VALUES(#{tenant},#{view.paymentId},#{view.orderId},#{view.amount},#{view.currency},'UNKNOWN') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payment_id=payment_id
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id,tenant_id,order_id,CAST(amount AS CHAR) amount,currency,status,transaction_id FROM payment_sandbox_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_sandbox_ledger SET status=#{status},transaction_id=#{transaction} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN')
UPDATE payment_sandbox_ledger SET status='CLOSED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} AND status='OPEN'
mapper.sql: status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN') AND check_attempts<5 AND check_transient_failures<#{transientMax} AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,payment_id,order_id,check_attempts,check_transient_failures FROM payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND ORDER BY next_check_at,payment_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id FROM ((SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM payment_attempt FORCE INDEX(ix_payment_tenant_check) WHERE status='UNKNOWN' AND tenant_id>#{after} AND ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT #{limit}) UNION (SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM payment_attempt FORCE INDEX(ix_payment_tenant_check) WHERE status='OPEN' AND tenant_id>#{after} AND ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT #{limit})) t ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_attempt SET check_attempts=check_attempts+1,next_check_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delay},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} AND check_attempts=#{attempts} AND check_attempts<5 AND status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN') AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE payment_attempt SET check_attempts=check_attempts-1,check_transient_failures=check_transient_failures+1,next_check_at=TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,1000*#{delayMillis},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),check_error=#{error} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} AND check_attempts=#{claimed} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN')
UPDATE payment_attempt SET check_error=#{error} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(check_attempts<5 AND check_transient_failures<#{transientMax} AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),0) due,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(IF(check_attempts<5 AND check_transient_failures<#{transientMax} AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),next_check_at,NULL)),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) oldest_due_age_seconds,COALESCE(SUM(check_attempts>=5 OR check_transient_failures>=#{transientMax}),0) quarantined FROM payment_attempt WHERE status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN')
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_attempt SET check_attempts=0,check_transient_failures=0,next_check_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN')

UPDATE payment_attempt SET refund_reserved=refund_reserved+CAST(#{amount} AS DECIMAL(18,2)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} AND status='PAID' AND refund_reserved+CAST(#{amount} AS DECIMAL(18,2))<=amount
